colors.description: The palette comes from the Agrowisata unit logos: tea-leaf green, sunrise orange and highland navy. Always use semantic tokens, never raw hex codes.

semantic.title: Semantic Tokens
semantic.description: Colors named by what they are for. These are what components and apps use.

primitives.title: Primitive Palette
primitives.description: Every raw color scale. Do not use these directly in components — use the semantic tokens above.

usage.bg-brand: Brand top bar, ticket header, selected chip
usage.status-success-text: Success text on light green (passes AA)
usage.status-warning-text: Warning text on light orange (passes AA)
usage.status-danger-text: Danger text on light red (passes AA)
usage.status-info-text: Info text on light blue (passes AA)
usage.accent-gold: Premium labels, overline on dark backgrounds

typography.description: Two typefaces: Fraunces for brand moments, Plus Jakarta Sans for the whole interface.

fonts.title: Typefaces
fonts.fraunces: Soft serif for heroes, destination names and large section titles. Matches the wordmark of the unit logos.
fonts.jakarta: Sans-serif for the whole interface: screen titles, body text, labels and numbers.

styles.title: Text Styles
styles.description: One typo-* class sets the font, size, line height, weight and letter spacing from Figma.

rules.oneFraunces: At most one Fraunces text per mobile screen (usually the hero or the unit name).
rules.overline: An uppercase overline in text-fg-accent sits above a title to name the unit or category.
rules.noColor: typo-* classes do not set a color — combine them with a text-fg-* class.

spacing.description: All spacing follows a 4px grid so layouts feel airy and consistent.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: In Tailwind, 1 unit = 4px. For example: p-4 = 16px, gap-6 = 24px.

radius.description: Rounded corners inspired by leaves and hills — soft, never rigid. Avoid sharp 0px corners on cards and buttons.

elevation.description: Shadows are tinted dark green (#0F2921), never pure black.

guidelines.title: Guidelines
guidelines.borderOrShadow: A default card uses a 1px border OR Elevation/1 — never both.
guidelines.noHeavy: Avoid heavy or pure black shadows.
